plan.title: Intara y'Iburasirazuba
plan.lead: Igiciro gishoboka mu mezi atatu ari imbere.
plan.anomaly: Ihinduka ry'umusaruro rigereranya igihembwe n'impuzandengo y'ibihembwe bitatu byabanje by'inyuguti imwe. Ubushakashatsi bwa NISR ku buhinzi bw'ibihembwe, 2018 kugeza 2026.
proof.title: Ibyavuye mu isuzuma
proof.netWhy: Igipimo cy'ibyangirika, igiciro cy'imifuka n'inyungu y'inguzanyo biracyabuze.

proof.losingMore: Ibyemezo {count} byahombye. Uturere dukoresha igiciro cy'intara dusangiye inzira imwe y'igiciro, bityo igihembwe kimwe kibi gishobora kugaragara inshuro zirenze imwe.
about.title: Uburyo
about.lead: Hunika igereranya kugurisha ubu no kubika amezi 1 kugeza kuri 4. Ikoresha intera y'imyaka ishize, kandi igira inama yo kubika gusa iyo inyungu ishoboka igaragara kandi ibihe bibi bikaba bito. Buri mubare wageragejwe ku masarura yashize muri Ibimenyetso.
about.notice: Inama ishingiye ku biciro byashize. Si isezerano.
about.wfp: Ibiciro bya WFP, binyuze kuri HDX, byakuwe ku wa 25 Ukwakira 2026. Ukwezi gushya mu dosiye: Kanama 2026.
about.cpi: Igipimo cy'ibiciro by'ibiribwa mu cyaro cya NISR kugeza Nzeri 2026, cyatangajwe ku wa 10 Ukwakira 2026.
about.sas: Imbonerahamwe z'uturere z'ubushakashatsi bwa NISR ku buhinzi bw'ibihembwe, Ibihembwe A na B, 2018 kugeza 2026. Igishya: Igihembwe B 2026, cyatangajwe ku wa 22 Nzeri 2026.
about.ahs: Ubushakashatsi bw'ingo z'abahinzi bwa 2024 ntiburaboneka muri iyi porogaramu. Bugomba gukurwa ku rubuga rwa NISR.
plan.path: Inzira y'igiciro, RWF ku kilo mu mafaranga y'uyu munsi
plan.pathNote: Igiciro gishoboka n'intera ishoboka mu mezi ari imbere, igiciro cya {month} gisimbura icy'uyu munsi.

proof.alwaysStore: Kubika buri sarura muri {option} amezi 4 byari kuzana ugereranyije {amount} RWF ku toni ariko bigahomba {share} by'inshuro. Gukurikiza Hunika byahombye {ours} by'inshuro.

proof.bySeasonNote: Impuzandengo y'uturere turindwi. Igihembwe kiri kuri zeru ni icyo Hunika yavuzemo kugurisha.

about.team: Shima Serein, mu marushanwa ya NISR 2026 Big Data Hackathon. Uburenganzira bwose ku byatanzwe bwegurirwa NISR.
about.ai: Ikoreshwa rya AI: kode, uburyo bwo gutunganya amakuru n'inyandiko za mbere byanditswe hifashishijwe Claude, umufasha wa AI, hakurikijwe igitabo cy'itsinda. Buri mubare uva ku masoko yavuzwe hano.
about.ahsUsed: Ubushakashatsi bwa NISR ku ngo z'abahinzi 2024 (ingo {n} zabajijwe): ingo zigera ku bihumbi {households} mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba zihinga ibigori cyangwa ibishyimbo. Umusaruro uringaniye w'Igihembwe A: ibiro {maize} by'ibigori, ibiro {beans} by'ibishyimbo. {coop} ziri muri koperative; {markets} by'abanyamuryango bavuga ko ibagurishiriza umusaruro, ariko {storage} gusa ni bo ibonera ububiko. {loan} basabye inguzanyo, kandi kugura ibiribwa ni yo mpamvu yagarutsweho cyane. Ubushakashatsi ntibubaza ku igurishwa, ububiko cyangwa ibyangirika by'umusaruro, bityo ibipimo by'ibyangirika biva mu bigeragezo byatangajwe.
proof.lead: Ibyemezo {n} byo mu isarura byashize mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, {years}. Buri cyemezo cyakoresheje amakuru yari yatangajwe mbere y'uwo munsi gusa, hanyuma kigereranywa n'igiciro nyakuri nyuma y'ibyangirika, imifuka, amafaranga y'ububiko n'inyungu.
